wsectl agent guide (full)

This is an unofficial tool and is not affiliated with Worksection.

Operating rules:
  Prefer --json or --ndjson. Never parse table output.
  Use --out FILE for large responses.
  Check meta.truncated and meta.warnings.
  Use --schema --json before selecting fields for unfamiliar commands.
  Use --profile NAME when account context matters.
  Avoid request loops; Worksection documents a 1 request/second limit.
  Never print tokens unless the user explicitly requests token material.

Common workflows:
  wsectl projects list --json
  wsectl tasks search --query "invoice" --json
  wsectl tasks all --extra text,files --json --out /tmp/tasks.json
  wsectl api call get_users_schedule --param datestart=01.05.2026 --param dateend=31.05.2026 --json

Discover capabilities:
  wsectl commands --json
  wsectl api actions --json
  wsectl api schema ACTION --json
  wsectl tasks search --schema --json
  wsectl doctor --json

Setup and authentication:
  wsectl profiles add default --account-url https://company.worksection.com --auth-type oauth2
  Set WSECTL_CLIENT_ID and WSECTL_CLIENT_SECRET in your shell.
  wsectl auth login --client-id "$WSECTL_CLIENT_ID"
  wsectl auth status --json
  wsectl doctor --api --json

  For desktop use: config.toml stores profiles; keyring stores tokens and client secrets.
  Use wsectl profiles use NAME to change the default profile.
  Use --profile NAME or WSECTL_PROFILE for temporary profile selection.

  Admin token: profiles add admin --auth-type admin_token --secret-ref keyring:wsectl/admin
  Encrypted file: profiles add portable --secret-ref encrypted-file:/path/to/secret.json

  For CI: set WSECTL_ACCOUNT_URL and WSECTL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

Output and errors:
  Success: {"status":"ok","data":...,"meta":{...}}
  Error:   {"status":"error","error":{"code":...,"message":...},"meta":{...}}
  meta.contract_version and meta.response_shape describe the static output contract.
  Exit codes: 2 usage, 3 auth, 4 permission, 5 network, 6 API, 7 rate limit, 8 truncation.
  Use --fail-on-truncated when incomplete data must fail the run.

API compatibility notes:
  First-class commands normalize known Worksection quirks; api call uses raw API params.
  projects list --status archived sends filter=archive.
  tasks search --query TEXT sends a Worksection filter, not a search parameter.
  costs --timer sends is_timer; files images filters client-side.
  API calls use query-parameter POST mode; form-encoded API bodies are not supported.

Safety model:
  The MVP is read-only. Known Worksection mutation actions are rejected before a request.
  Secrets live in keyring, environment, encrypted-file, or explicit plaintext stores.
  Do not expose WSECTL_ACCESS_TOKEN, WSECTL_REFRESH_TOKEN, or WSECTL_CLIENT_SECRET.

Worksection limits:
  Default client rate: 1 request/second.
  Some endpoints can return at most 10,000 records.
  API params stay in the query string; very long filters can still hit URL limits.

Command catalog:
  wsectl api                     Low-level Worksection API access
  wsectl api actions             List known Worksection API actions
  wsectl api call                Call a read-only Worksection API action
  wsectl api schema              Show known action parameters
  wsectl auth                    Authenticate with Worksection
  wsectl auth login              Start OAuth login or store manually supplied credentials
  wsectl auth logout             Delete stored credentials for the active profile
  wsectl auth refresh            Refresh OAuth token when stored refresh token is available
  wsectl auth status             Show auth status
  wsectl commands                List public commands
  wsectl comments                Read comments
  wsectl comments list           List task comments
  wsectl completion              Generate shell completion scripts
  wsectl completion bash         Generate the completion script for bash
  wsectl completion fish         Generate the completion script for fish
  wsectl completion powershell   Generate the completion script for powershell
  wsectl completion zsh          Generate the completion script for zsh
  wsectl costs                   Read costs
  wsectl costs list              Read costs
  wsectl costs total             Read costs
  wsectl docs                    Documentation helpers
  wsectl docs generate           Generate command reference
  wsectl doctor                  Diagnose configuration, credentials, and optional API connectivity
  wsectl files                   Read and download files
  wsectl files download          Download a file
  wsectl files images            List image files
  wsectl files list              List files
  wsectl files task-attachments  List task attachments
  wsectl help                    Show detailed help
  wsectl me                      Get authorized user info
  wsectl profiles                Manage Worksection profiles
  wsectl profiles add            Add or update a profile
  wsectl profiles list           List profiles
  wsectl profiles remove         Remove a profile
  wsectl profiles show           Show a profile
  wsectl profiles use            Set current profile
  wsectl projects                Read projects
  wsectl projects events         Get project events
  wsectl projects get            Get a project
  wsectl projects groups         List project groups
  wsectl projects list           List projects
  wsectl projects team           Get project team
  wsectl tags                    Read task and project tags
  wsectl tags project            Read project tags
  wsectl tags project groups     List tag groups
  wsectl tags project list       List tags
  wsectl tags task               Read task tags
  wsectl tags task groups        List tag groups
  wsectl tags task list          List tags
  wsectl tasks                   Read and search tasks
  wsectl tasks all               List all account tasks
  wsectl tasks discussion        Get task comments
  wsectl tasks get               Get a task
  wsectl tasks list              List project tasks
  wsectl tasks relations         Get task relations
  wsectl tasks search            Search tasks
  wsectl tasks subscribers       Get task subscribers
  wsectl tasks subtasks          Get task subtasks
  wsectl timers                  Read timers
  wsectl timers list             List enabled member timers
  wsectl timers mine             Get current user timer
  wsectl users                   Read users, groups, contacts, and schedules
  wsectl users contact-groups    List contact groups
  wsectl users contacts          List contacts
  wsectl users groups            List user groups
  wsectl users list              List users
  wsectl users schedule          List users' non-working days
  wsectl webhooks                Read webhooks
  wsectl webhooks list           List webhooks
